pilot_rows.title: Logitech G610 Orion Red Backlit Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
pilot_rows.source_review: This keyboard feels amazing with its cherry MX Red switches, it clearly has amazing build quality and is meant to last. Plus, with the logitech gaming software, you can configure how the LEDs either breathe, stay solid or create a cool wave effect on your keyboard (Which it does by default). Just one quick note is that the LEDs are white only and this is not RGB, but if you're just looking for an amazing build quality keyboard with a good backlight that will last you, you can look no further, I highly recommend this keyboard to anyone who's heavily into PC gaming.
